config.stealthpipe.title: StealthPipe Configuration
config.stealthpipe.relayAddress.descript:
Specifies where StealthPipe should try to relay the data to.

§6Remove the leading slash, and include https:// or http:// in the URL.
config.stealthpipe.onlineMode.descriptio: Whether to allow Minecraft to authenticate the connecting player through Mojang when connecting to a LAN world.
config.stealthpipe.connectionAttempts.de: Controls the number of attempts to reach the relay before giving up.
config.stealthpipe.webrtcClientEnabled.d:
Whether or not the client should attempt to establish a direct peer-to-peer connection with WebRTC.
§6Using WebRTC requires sharing your IP address with the other peer (in this case, the host).
config.stealthpipe.webrtcHostEnabled.des:
Whether or not the host should allow inbound WebRTC connection requests.
§WebRTC requires sharing your IP address with the other players.
§rDisable if you don't want to share your IP address, or if something isn't working.
config.stealthpipe.showConnectingInfo.de: Whether or not to show the connecting info at the top of the screen
config.stealthpipe.packetBatching.descri:
Groups packets that are sent at roughly the same interval to increase reliability and decrease relay load.
§6Even though rare in StealthPipe V6+, it might slightly increase ping.
config.stealthpipe.packetBatchingInterva:
Controls the interval of packet batching.
Higher number = more are grouped together = lower overhead but higher ping.
Lower number = less are grouped together = higher overhead but lower ping.
config.stealthpipe.wrtcIceFailure.descri:
Simulates ICE candidates failure.

§6You should never enable this option unless you are a developer.
config.stealthpipe.logIceCandidates.desc:
Whether or not to log all the info going through WebRTC signaling. Only enable this to report an issue, and always send logs privately with this option enabled.

§6Enabling this will reveal sensitive info such as IP addresses and network topology!
config.stealthpipe.abnormalDisconnectCli: Simulates an abnormal disconnect as a client only
config.stealthpipe.abnormalDisconnectHos: Simulates an abnormal disconnect as a host only
config.stealthpipe.failureDelay.descript: Number of seconds before initiating simulated failure
config.stealthpipe.latencySpikes.descrip: Simulates huge latency spikes (of 1 second) to aid in finding RACE conditions.
config.stealthpipe.latencySpikesDirectio: Controls which direction the latency will spike in.
config.stealthpipe.latencyBaseline.descr: Controls the baseline latency for debugging
config.stealthpipe.safeInject.descriptio:
Uses the channel's event loop to safely inject a packet.
May increase latency.
config.stealthpipe.warnCorruptedData.des: If enabled, data corruption warnings will be shown in Chat.
